Same-id same-digest re-enters the existing state machine unless terminal success or duplicate; same-id different-digest preserves the original evidence and becomes immutable canonical payload-conflict DEAD.

Use null last_event_id for snapshot-only checkpoints and add no core schema migration or competing delivery ledger.
projectionAndRecovery: Implement closed states CURRENT, STALE, REFETCH_PENDING, GAP and QUARANTINED with monotonic required and observed event evidence.
Implement covered contiguous no-refetch, ordinary refetch, missing-sequence backfill, bounded GAP recovery, eventless OWNER_BASELINE and retry-safe inbox projection reconciliation.
Perform no network call inside a database transaction and fence final success or failure with inbox lock token plus exact projection_version.
Do not fast-forward the shared offset from an ordinary contiguous owner response; only sealed gap or baseline recovery may checkpoint the verified owner relationship revision.
ownerClientAndReadGuard: Call exact SVC-PEP-HRM-007 for the tenant current business date using generated XCON-027, a non-regressing minimum relationship revision and an independent current TIM003OwnerGrantV1 authority lookup.

Validate TLS 1.3 identity, signed request binding, closed response or problem shape, dedicated RS256 key purpose, digests, temporal evidence, authoritative zone/date and every grant revision; unknown or unverified errors yield zero facts.
Return only unexpired CURRENT current-date facts with exact current zone and authority revisions and no unresolved inbox row after generated XCON-027 and digest reconstruction.
Past or future dates, unavailable authority, expiry, corruption, unresolved inbox, direct People database access, self-authorizing JWT and stored-authority reuse fail closed.
defaultOffGate: Consumer, owner client and recovery workers remain conditional on a default-false switch and an empty enrolled-tenant set.
While TIM_CLOSE_TRUSTED_OWNER_HEADER_ISSUER remains open, only fail-closed authority ports, adapters and test doubles may exist.
No route, menu, UI, browser entry, production broker binding or customer-data execution is authorized.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: XCON-004 remains the four-field closed EmploymentChanged.v1 business contract and no sensitive or Time-owned fact is added.
The transport type is dwp.hris.people.employment-changed.v1 with source urn:dwp:people:hris:employment, WORK_RELATIONSHIP aggregate identity and relationship revision ordering.

Envelope subject, aggregate id and sequence exactly equal WORK_RELATIONSHIP/{relationshipPublicId}, relationshipPublicId and newAggregateVersion; mismatch, unknown type or unsupported major fails closed to the shared DLQ.

HRIS-HRM registers the canonical event major, captures one publication Instant, and writes both canonical envelope and legacy compatibility evidence in one transaction without changing legacy published_at, direct broker I/O or treating legacy aggregate metadata as canonical.

XCON-027 provides exact typed, minimized current-business-date relationship and nested assignment revisions for recovery, and new SVC-PEP-HRM-007 exposes it only through workload-authenticated TIME_ABSENCE_V1 exact relationship recovery while SVC-PEP-HRM-002 remains unchanged; historical or future dates fail closed until an effective-dated worker-status owner exists.

Wrong workload, tenant, issuer, audience, client, subject, mTLS confirmation, method, path, query, token time, replay id, correlation, purpose, projection, field set, business zone/date, scope/content/evidence digest, signature, revision or expiry returns no usable owner facts and produces owner audit evidence.
HRIS-TIM reuses the shared inbox, offset, retry, replay and DLQ ledger and creates no competing delivery ledger.

Same-id same-digest delivery is idempotent, same-id different-digest delivery is quarantined, older shared-offset revision is a no-op, a covered contiguous revision uses the no-refetch fast path, and any unresolved or gap inbox row blocks current reads until reconciled and trusted recovery succeeds.
V14 creates exactly one tenant-isolated abs_employment_relationship_projections table with forced RLS, closed states, deterministic assignment facts and projection-version CAS.

Owner recovery never regresses a relationship revision and atomically binds projection CAS replacement, required exact offset CAS, GAP-mode DEFERRED-only settlement or eventless OWNER_BASELINE zero-row settlement, replay audit and structured audit evidence; REPLAY_PENDING, DEAD and payload conflicts are never snapshot-settled, and snapshot-only recovery stores no fabricated last event id.

Non-CURRENT, expired, inbox-blocked or non-current-date projections fail closed for absence evaluation; an eligible eventless projection miss schedules a fenced trusted owner baseline, a retry-safe reconciler repairs gap/quarantine state after crashes, and no direct People database access, leave request mutation, balance mutation or approval behavior is introduced.
Producer, query and consumer remain default OFF with zero enrolled tenants, no route or menu, no production broker and zero business-completion credit until later admission and activation authority.

targetedVerification.policy: Run each affected TIM-003 class or bounded database group once; diagnose and rerun only the smallest failed target; run one bounded TIM-003 lane gate before module result; never run a repository-wide or full-module suite per correction.
